title.zh: 损伤与激活：退火要修复但不能扩散过头
title.en: Damage and activation: anneal to repair without excessive diffusion

subtitle.zh: 晶格损伤 / 再结晶 /电学激活 / 热预算
subtitle.en: Lattice damage / recrystallization / electrical activation / thermal budget

body.zh: 1 形成注入损伤；高能离子进入硅片；产生晶格损伤和间隙原子。
body.en: 1 Create implant damage Energetic ions enter silicon causing lattice damage and interstitial atoms

body.zh: 通过受控加热提供
body.en: Controlled heating supplies

body.zh: 损伤区域逐步恢复为
body.en: The damaged region gradually recovers

body.zh: 部分注入原子进入；晶格替位位置，获得电学活性。
body.en: Some implanted atoms occupy substitutional lattice sites and become electrically active

body.zh: 退火同时引起掺杂扩散
body.en: Annealing also drives dopant diffusion

body.zh: 通过多种表征确认；測试电学参数；评估工艺结果
body.en: Multiple characterization methods confirm Measure electrical parameters and evaluate process results

body.zh: 非晶化区/晶格损伤
body.en: Amorphous region / lattice damage

body.zh: 热能驱动原子迁移；与缺陷消除
body.en: Thermal energy drives atomic migration and defect removal

body.zh: 晶格修复；缺陷减少
body.en: Lattice repair Fewer defects

body.zh: •硅原子；替位掺杂原子；（电学活性）
body.en: Silicon atom Substitutional dopant atom (electrically active)

body.zh: 掺杂向纵深与横向扩散；缺陷持续演化
body.en: Dopants diffuse vertically and laterally Defects continue to evolve

body.zh: 注入导入原子，退火把它转化为可用电学掺杂；修复损伤、激活电活性，但必须控制扩散与缺陷
body.en: Implantation introduces atoms; annealing converts them into useful electrical doping Repair damage and activate dopants while controlling diffusion and defects

body.zh: 峰值温度与时间；决定原子迁移能力与修复程度
body.en: Peak temperature and time Determine atomic mobility and repair extent

body.zh: 升降温或脉冲方式；影响激活效率与热损伤控制
body.en: Heating/cooling ramp or pulse scheme Affects activation efficiency and thermal-damage control

body.zh: 环境与表面覆盖；影响表面反应与杂质行为
body.en: Ambient and surface covering Affect surface reactions and impurity behavior

body.zh: 剂量与损伤状态；决定初始缺陷浓度与激活难度
body.en: Dose and damage state Determine initial defect concentration and activation difficulty

body.zh: 修复与激活增强；•晶格损伤减少；• 替位掺杂增加；• 载流子浓度上升；• 片阻降低
body.en: Stronger repair and activation • Less lattice damage • More substitutional doping • Higher carrier concentration • Lower sheet resistance

body.zh: 扩散、结深与缺陷；演化加剧；• 掺杂扩散加剧；• 结深增大；•瞬态缺陷增多；• 轮廓变钝；• 器件特性恶化
body.en: Diffusion, junction depth and defects evolve more strongly • More dopant diffusion • Deeper junctions • More transient defects • Broader profiles • Degraded device characteristics

body.zh: 需要在激活与扩散之间取得最佳平衡
body.en: Find the optimum balance between activation and diffusion

body.zh: 激活不足/ 片阻偏高；退火能量不足或损伤过重；导致替位率低。
body.en: Insufficient activation / high sheet resistance Insufficient anneal energy or excessive damage leads to a low substitutional fraction

body.zh: 瞬态增强扩散；非平衡缺陷促进掺杂；异常扩散，结深超预期。
body.en: Transient enhanced diffusion Nonequilibrium defects promote abnormal dopant diffusion and excessive junction depth

body.zh: 残余缺陷；间隙原子、空位团等；未完全消除，影响可靠性。
body.en: Residual defects Interstitial atoms and vacancy clusters remain and affect reliability

body.zh: 偏聚或团簇；掺杂原子聚集形成簇，；降低电学活性。
body.en: Segregation or clustering Dopant atoms aggregate into clusters, reducing electrical activity

body.zh: 片阻测量；评估整体电学激活程度
body.en: Sheet-resistance measurement Assess overall electrical activation

body.zh: Hall 测量；获取载流子浓度；与迁移率
body.en: Hall measurement Obtain carrier concentration and mobility

body.zh: SIMS 深度分析；分析掺杂浓度分布与结深
body.en: SIMS depth analysis Analyze dopant profile and junction depth

body.zh: TEM / XRD；观察晶格修复与；缺陷状态
body.en: TEM / XRD Observe lattice repair and defect states

body.zh: 漏电特性；评估结质量与器；件可靠性
body.en: Leakage characteristics Assess junction quality and device reliability

body.zh: 2 施加退火热预算
body.en: 2 Apply anneal thermal budget

body.zh: 3 晶格再结晶
body.en: 3 Recrystallize lattice

body.zh: 4 掺杂替位激活
body.en: 4 Activate substitutional dopants

body.zh: 5 扩散与缺陷竞争
body.en: 5 Diffusion competes with defects

body.zh: 6 进行电学验证
body.en: 6 Verify electrically

body.zh: 原子迁移与缺陷修复的能量。
body.en: energy for atomic migration and defect repair.

body.zh: 有序晶格结构。
body.en: an ordered lattice structure.

body.zh: 和缺陷演化，需要权衡控制。
body.en: and defect evolution, requiring balanced control.

body.zh: 激活效果与器件性能。
body.en: activation and device performance.
